title: Protect the Academy! The Discipline Head's Struggle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Scandal at the Prestigious Tracen Academy?!
Has laxity struck the elite school? Morals in blatant disarray..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What in the world is thissss?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Inappeasable Appetites: Local Diners in Tears,"
"Public Nuisance! Is the Ghost Actually a Super-Speed Horsegirl?!"—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's three times already this month!
And this time, of all things, they're calling out a 'moral breakdown'!!

With the racing world garnering more and more attention lately,
gossip rags had apparently hopped on the trend of targeting racers.

Tracen Academy had tightened security and warned the student body,
so none of the issues described in the articles were actually happening, but—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if the article is totally off-base, getting slammed like this
might mean the Disciplinary Committee... or rather, *I* got too soft.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That settles it!
Until peace is restored to our campus, I'm ramping up our disciplinary crackdowns!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As the Disciplinary Committee Head,
I'll protect everyone from these nasty rumors...! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! You're two seconds late!
A late arrival at school leads to a late start on the track!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You over there!
Your skirt is a whole millimeter shorter than regulation!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! The court is supposed to be split evenly in two!
Spilling over the line is strictly forbidden, even during breaks!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah, it's almost curfew!
And I still haven't cracked down on everything...!
choice_data_list: Feels like you might be overdoing it, though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Tiny lapses in discipline lead to massive problems down the line!
Tomorrow, I'm gonna crack down even harder!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, those two are leaving the dorms right now... That's dangerous,
and it could spark a scandal! We have to go after them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! Even senior division students
aren't allowed in an arcade at this hour! That's a disciplinary violation!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Gah! The Disciplinary Committee Head?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Curfew is right around the corner, so head back now!
If you've got time to fool around, you'd be way better off training!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We're training all the time anyway!
'Fool around'...? You sound just like my Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We run from morning till night, and even on days off they tell us to practice on our own!
Is it really so wrong to want a little breather once in a while?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
And now the rules are suddenly way stricter lately, too...
I'm so sick of feeling suffocated all the time!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Th-That's...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No! What you two are trying to do is still against the rules!
No matter the circumstances, the regulations must be upheld!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And maintaining discipline is my duty!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: ...Ghk!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come on, back to the dorms! As the Disciplinary Committee Head,
I can't turn a blind eye to this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much
for tagging along with me so late...
choice_data_list: You don't seem like your usual energetic self.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, well... I did my job and upheld the rules, but...
I've still got this lingering knot in my chest, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just can't get what they said out of my head.
I know what they were trying to do was wrong, but—
choice_data_list: Maybe meeting them halfway was what was needed.
Maybe you needed to see things from their side.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Meeting them halfway...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We run from morning till night, and even on days off they tell us to practice on our own!
Is it really so wrong to want a little breather once in a while?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I was only thinking about enforcing the rules.
Just now, and before that too.

While she believed she hadn't acted wrongly, it was clear that
the students' side of the story was weighing heavily on her mind.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's try talking it out with them.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Talk it out... Yes!
As the Disciplinary Committee Head, I'll meet them halfway with all my heart!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'd expect nothing less from you, Trainer!
Compared to you, I've still got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!!!
I'm gonna push myself even harder from now onnnn!!
